verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own headless, programmatic interfaces. The official Snowflake CLI creates, manages and deploys apps across workloads. The SQL API is a REST API for running queries and managing deployments, such as provisioning users and roles or creating tables. The resource-management REST APIs ship OpenAPI specs and Postman collections. Together these let automation run without the UI, though CI use is only implied. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions or other CI integration), documented non-interactive/service authentication for automation, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
